results.evidence: The 3,200 ft in under a mile figure is a description of the peak's east face rising above the Hayes River drainage directly beneath it, not the climb from the Hayes River Guard Station camp (~1,750 ft, ~3.5 mi from the summit), from which the gain must be at least ~4,650 ft. No outside source states a route gain for this scramble, and the itinerary day gains sum to gain_ft (5,100), so day 3 cannot be changed without an unsourced change to gain_ft. Left open; the summit elevation itself is also disputed (see below).

The row's 6,397 ft matches the encyclopedia figure, but two topo-derived sources disagree with it: one lists Norton at 6,319 ft and another displays 1,926 m (6,319 ft) — close to the schedule's 6,321. The header elevation comes from the area row, so changing high_point_ft/overview/waypoint alone would open a new contradiction; the peak's true elevation needs an area-level decision.

The only outside statement found is a generic weather sentence saying June through August offer the most favorable weather for the peak; it is not route-specific beta, and no trip report or second source was found establishing whether June is in season for this interior scramble versus the row's late July-September window.

Hayes River Guard Station is 16.1 mi from Whiskey Bend and Mary's Falls 8.8 mi. The Elkhorn waypoint's 14.3 mi appears to be a copied 'about 14.3 miles south of Elwha' location figure (measured from Elwha, not Whiskey Bend); one search summary and a 23-mi round-trip listing suggest ~11.5 mi from Whiskey Bend, but no clearly attributable pair of sources was reached. The itinerary's daily miles (11.5 / 5.3 / 16.8) appear to be measured from Whiskey Bend while its day-1 note starts at Madison Falls ~7 mi earlier; fixing that needs sourced per-day figures.

The park's Elwha River Trail page says the washout adds an additional 7 miles to reach the Whiskey Bend trailhead; an independent description measures 6.9 mi (the 4.5-4.6 mi Whiskey Bend Road plus the Olympic Hot Springs Road segment from Madison Falls). One hiking-association page says 6.2, the outlier. The approach and road.driveNote already say ~7; cal, watch_out and trailheadDirection are aligned to it.
